echo "=== examination process detail ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:8080/process/examination | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log(JSON.stringify({status:j.status,restarts:j.restarts,is_running:j.is_running,ready:j.is_ready,exit:j.exit_code,pid:j.pid,start:j.process_start_time,last:j.last_activity_time},null,2))})'
